scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:up && sleep 4 && pnpm --filter api prisma:push && pnpm --filter api seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
